```{r setup, echo=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(tidyverse)
library(purrr)
source(here::here("Analysis/utils.R"))
library(gtsummary)
library(lubridate)
library(gt)
library(survey)


# Load the dataset from the file path
data <- data <- readRDS(here::here(params$data_path)) %>% 
  mutate(study_year_tl = lubridate::year(eff_tl),
         study_year_tr = lubridate::year(eff_tr)) %>% 
  filter(
    out_class_metric == "occurrence" &  exp_class == "flood"
  )

direction_summary <- data %>% 
  group_by(studykey) %>% 
  summarise_directions(thresh = 0.7) %>% 
  mutate(a_direction_col = overall_dir) %>% 
  select(studykey, a_direction_col) %>% 
  mutate(a_direction_col = case_when(
    a_direction_col == "higher" ~ "positive",
    a_direction_col %in% c("lower","uncertain") ~ "non-positive",
    TRUE ~ a_direction_col
  ))

data <- data %>% 
  left_join(
    direction_summary,
    by="studykey"
  ) %>% 
  filter(
    a_direction_col %in% c("positive","non-positive")
  )

```

```{r}
# Helper function
library(gtsummary)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(forcats)
library(rlang)

make_summary_table1 <- function(data, var, rename_var = NULL, expected_levels = NULL) {
  var_sym <- sym(var)

  data_clean <- data %>% 
    distinct(studykey, !!sym(var), a_direction_col) %>% 
    mutate(across(all_of(var), ~tolower(trimws(.)))) %>%
    mutate(a_direction_col = ifelse(a_direction_col == "non-positive",'unclassified',a_direction_col))%>%
    filter(a_direction_col %in% c("positive", "unclassified")) %>%
    mutate(
      a_direction_col = factor(a_direction_col, levels = c("positive", "unclassified")),
      !!var_sym := if (!is.numeric(.data[[var]]) && !is.null(expected_levels))
        factor(.data[[var]], levels = expected_levels)
      else
        .data[[var]],
      is_dummy = FALSE
    )

  observed <- data_clean %>% distinct(a_direction_col, !!var_sym)

  expected <- expand.grid(
    a_direction_col = levels(data_clean$a_direction_col),
    level = expected_levels,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  ) %>%
    rename(!!var_sym := level) %>%
    mutate(!!var_sym := factor(.data[[var]], levels = expected_levels))

  missing <- anti_join(expected, observed, by = c("a_direction_col", var))
  dummy_rows <- missing %>%
    mutate(studykey = "dummy", is_dummy = TRUE)

  data_full <- bind_rows(data_clean, dummy_rows)

  label_arg <- if (!is.null(rename_var)) set_names(list(rename_var), var) else NULL

  is_categorical <- !is.numeric(data[[var]])

  test_arg <- if (is_categorical) {
  set_names(list("chisq.test"), var)
    } else {
  set_names(list("t.test"), var)
    }
  
  tbl <- tbl_summary(
    data_full %>% filter(!is_dummy),
    by = a_direction_col,
    include = all_of(var),
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no",
    label = label_arg
  )

  tbl <- tryCatch(
    {
    tbl %>%
      add_p(test = test_arg) %>%
      modify_caption("**Comparison by Direction (with 0-filled categories)**")
    },
    error = function(e) {
      warning("add_p() failed: ", conditionMessage(e))
      tbl %>%
        modify_caption("**Comparison by Direction (p-value not applicable)**")
    }
  )

  return(tbl)
}

```

## Table 1. Spatial-temporal characteristics
### Table 1. Study region
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data, var = "continent", rename_var = "Category" ,expected_levels = c("asia",'africa','other'))
```

### Table 1. Study spatial scale
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data, "admin_level", "Category", expected_levels = c("sub-national",'national','regional'))
```

### Table 1. % of years with WHO reported cases 
```{r}
who_data<-read.csv(here::here(params$who_data_path)) %>%
  tidyr::separate(obs,c('time_left','time_right','suspected_cases','deaths','location_id','primary'),sep = ';',remove=T) %>%
  filter(primary == 't') %>% 
  merge(.,read.csv(here::here(params$location_file_path)),by.x="location_id",by.y="id",all.x=TRUE) %>%
  filter(is.na(region)==F) %>%
  arrange(region) %>%
  mutate(country = as.factor(region),suspected_cases=as.numeric(suspected_cases)) %>% 
  filter(time_right >= as.Date("2000-01-01") & time_right <= as.Date("2023-12-31")) %>% 
  mutate(year = lubridate::year(time_right)) %>% 
  select(country,suspected_cases,year)

classified <- identify_endemicity(
    processed_data = data,
    who_data = who_data,
    group_col = "a_direction_col"
  ) %>%
    mutate(endemicity_group = case_when(
      percent_year_with_cases <= 50 ~ "0-50%",
      percent_year_with_cases > 50 & percent_year_with_cases <= 95 ~ "50-95%",
      percent_year_with_cases > 95 ~ ">95%"
    )) %>%
    mutate(
      endemicity_group = factor(endemicity_group, levels = c("0-50%", "50-95%", ">95%")),
      a_direction_col = factor(a_direction_col, levels = c("positive", "non-positive"))
    )

  country_level <- classified %>%
    select(country, a_direction_col, endemicity_group) %>%
    distinct()

tbl_summary(
    data = country_level,
    by = a_direction_col,
    include = endemicity_group,
    statistic = list(all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    missing = "no",
    label = list(endemicity_group = "Endemicity Group")
  ) %>%
    add_p(test = list(endemicity_group = "chisq.test")) %>%
    modify_caption("**Study Population by Endemicity Group and Direction**")

```

### Table 1. Any reported uncertainty
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data %>% group_by(studykey,a_direction_col) %>% 
                      summarize(study_report_sig = case_when(
                        any(sig_report) ~ TRUE,
                        TRUE ~ FALSE
                      )) %>% 
                      ungroup(), "study_report_sig", "Category", expected_levels = c("true","false"))
```

### Table 1. Any model adjustment
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data = data %>% group_by(studykey,a_direction_col) %>% 
                      summarize(study_adj_sig = case_when(
                        any(a_adjusted) ~ "TRUE",
                        a_adjusted == "not stated" ~ "Missing",
                        TRUE ~ "FALSE")) %>% 
                      ungroup(), "study_adj_sig", "Category", expected_levels = c("true","false")) 
```

## Table 1. Study quality
```{r}
# Study Quality
data <- data  %>% 
  get_study_scores()

study_avg_score <- data %>%
  group_by(studykey,a_direction_col) %>%
  summarize(min_tot_score_est = mean(min_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_exp_tot_score_est = mean(min_exp_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_out_tot_score_est = mean(min_out_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE),
            min_a_tot_score_est = mean(min_a_tot_score_est, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    min_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_tot_score_est == 9 ~ "9",
      min_tot_score_est <= 4 ~ "≤ 4",
      min_tot_score_est > 4 & min_tot_score_est < 9 ~ "5-8"
    ),
    min_out_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_out_tot_score_est == 4 ~ "4",
      TRUE ~ "<4"
    ),
    min_exp_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_exp_tot_score_est == 3 ~ "3",
      TRUE ~ "<3"
    ),
    min_a_tot_score_est = case_when(
      min_a_tot_score_est == 2 ~ "2",
      TRUE ~ "<2"
    ),
  )
```

### Table 1. Overall score (max=11)
```{r}
make_summary_table1(data =study_avg_score, "min_tot_score_est","Category", expected_levels = c('9','5-8','<=4'))
```
